newsitem.title: INDIA: Kashmir mine blast kills three Indian soldiers.
newsitem.headline: Kashmir mine blast kills three Indian soldiers.

text.p: Three soldiers died after a landmine believed planted by separatist guerrillas exploded on Monday in the troubled Indian state of Jammu and Kashmir, police said.
They said the blast at Shalteng on the outskirts of Srinagar, the state's summer capital, wounded another three soldiers and partially damaged an army vehicle.
More than a dozen militant groups are fighting India's rule in the state, the only Moslem majority province in the predominantly Hindu country.
Police and medical officials say more than 20,000 people have been killed since the rebellion broke out in 1990.
